investment_theses.thesis: Long BTC 6–12 month, short EUR/USD, via leveraged long BTC perps or 2x BTC ETF pair-trade against EURUSD short; stagflation fears and tariff litigation drive USD safe-haven bid and inflation-hedge demand for Bitcoin.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Trump-Canada tariff suit signals policy uncertainty; housing weakness + potential Fed hikes create stagflation narrative.
CoinDesk: France stablecoin tax and SEC tokenization resistance slow institutional crypto adoption, but BTC as uncorrelated hedge gains traction.
Strive $630M SATS IPO closure indicates institutional FOMO re-emerging; BTC allocation ambiguity suggests overallocation opportunity.
investment_theses.counter_view: Equity recovery in H2 2026 (earnings relief, tariff resolution) could weaken BTC safe-haven demand; regulatory crackdown (Kalshi Utah AG lawsuit signals enforcement appetite) may suppress on-chain volatility.
investment_theses.expression: Long 2x BTC ETF (BITB or IBIT leveraged products) + short EURUSD via FX futures or currency ETF (YXU); hedge with short SPY calls (upside scenario insurance).

investment_theses.thesis: Short Netflix (NFLX) 3–6 month; advertising revenue deceleration and guidance miss signal saturation; organizational churn post-earnings reduces execution confidence into 2026 H1.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Netflix posts earnings beat but shares fall on advertising and revenue guidance; Wall Street scrutinizing organizational changes.
High-performance inference framework adoption (DeepInfer for DeepSeek) suggests content personalization/recommendation edge eroding; competitive AI commoditization threatens pricing power.
investment_theses.counter_view: Password-sharing crackdown and ad-tier upsell could accelerate 2026 ARPUs faster than guidance implies; international market expansion (India, Southeast Asia) may unlock new growth.
investment_theses.expression: Short NFLX common stock or sell 3–6 month call spreads (sell 90 delta call, buy 80 delta call); pair with long PAYT or ROKU if betting on advertising platform rotation.

investment_theses.thesis: Long airline sector (UAL, DAL, AAL via ETF IYT or direct) 6–12 month; fuel hedges now locked in, leisure/business travel demand remains resilient despite higher fares; margin recovery floor higher than 2026 guidance assumes.
supporting_signals: CNBC: United Airlines cut profit outlook on fuel but travelers keep booking despite higher fares; structural resilience in demand underpins volume recovery.
Fuel price stabilization expected H2 2026 as Fed potentially eases (housing weakness signal) and geopolitical oil risk moderates.
investment_theses.counter_view: Recession in 2026 Q3–Q4 crushes business travel; aircraft delivery delays (Boeing 737 Max 10 ramp) reduce fleet capacity optionality; labor cost inflation erodes margin gains.
investment_theses.expression: Long IYT (Transportation ETF) or direct long UAL/DAL/AAL; hedge with short EEM (emerging markets often lead recession signals) or long PUT spreads on SPY for downside insurance.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Hyperliquid (HYPE) token 3–9 month; SEC tokenization resistance and institutional arbitrage opportunities create sustained on-chain DEX volume; Bitwise/Hyperliquid rule-change campaign signals endorsement from tier-1 asset managers.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops; institutional backing signals regulatory tailwind.
Crypto 2026 shutdown wave (82 projects) and Kalshi-Utah AG litigation suggest flight-to-quality in compliant, VC-backed platforms.
Trendy tokens PENGU, AERO, NEAR show sustained retail engagement; Hyperliquid ecosystem breadth (perpetuals, spot, points) scales faster than competitors.
investment_theses.counter_view: SEC enforcement or surprise tokenization ban halts growth; competing DEX (Dydx, Uniswap V4) captures market share; regulatory cost outpaces token value capture.
investment_theses.expression: Long HYPE token via spot purchase on Hyperliquid or secondary market (Coinbase if listing achieved); pair with hedging long DXY or short BTC if betting on governance volatility.

investment_theses.thesis: Long US 10-year yield (via TLT short or long DXY) 3–6 month; tariff uncertainty, housing weakness, and geopolitical friction (Ukraine, North Korea photos circulating) drive flight-to-quality and real rates higher despite Fed pause.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Housing data deteriorated; Trump-Canada tariff lawsuit signals policy chaos premium; Fed weighs more rate hikes.
BBC: Trump-Zelensky loggerheads suggest escalation risk; North Korea tension resurfaces—geopolitical premium in USD/bonds likely.
CoinDesk: France stablecoin tax and institutional objections to tokenization create regulatory tail risk; safe-haven flows into Treasuries.
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed capitulates and cuts rates in H2 2026; tariff resolution dealmaking surprises (recall Trump-Xi precedent 2020); risk-on equity recovery crushes yields.
investment_theses.expression: Long TLT (20+ year Treasury ETF) or short IEF (7–10 year Treasury); pair with long DXY (US Dollar Index) for FX diversification; hedge with long GOOG/MSFT calls if betting on AI growth offsetting macro concerns.
